payout_quote: Same day. You're paid every evening for that day's jobs and tips. You'll connect a debit card or bank account during onboarding so your payouts land quickly.
timing: Daily: paid every evening for that day's jobs and tips, to the debit card or bank account connected during onboarding.
eligibility: Approved Lugg mover: driver with a qualifying vehicle (2001 or newer) or moving helper (no vehicle needed); background check; debit card or bank account connected during onboarding.
steps: Sign up on the Lugg mover jobs page and complete onboarding: upload documents, clear the background check, and connect a debit card or bank account for same-day payouts.
Download the Lugger app once approved and pick up slots that fit your schedule.
Complete the day's jobs; pay for that day's jobs and tips lands every evening.
catches: No per-payout cashout fee is stated on the official page: same-day evening payout is the default for everyone, not an optional instant-cashout tier.
Background check cost is deducted from future earnings (amount not stated on the page); nothing is paid upfront.
Take-home figures are hourly averages; earnings vary by market, effort, vehicle type and demand.
Tips are split evenly with your crew on two-person jobs; Lugg takes no cut of tips.
Fuel, maintenance, insurance, tolls and other vehicle costs reduce net earnings (drivers get partial mileage and toll reimbursement).
No delivery-count promotion is quoted on the official page.
biggest_catch: There is no faster tier to optimize: same-day evening payout is simply how Lugg pays everyone, so the lever is working more slots, not payout timing.
